label: RSS: On New Entry
description: Fires once per new entry in an RSS or Atom feed. No account needed; only entries after activation fire, and the position survives restarts.

inputs.name: intervalSecs
inputs.label: Check every (seconds)
inputs.description: How often the feed is checked.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: Null when the entry gives none.

outputs.name: link
outputs.description: The entry's first link. Null when it has none.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Null when the feed gives none.

outputs.name: published
outputs.description: The entry's publish time (RFC 3339). Null when the feed gives none.

outputs.name: entry
outputs.description: The whole parsed entry (id, title, link, summary, published, author).

firesWith.item: { id: String, title?: String, link?: String, summary?: String, published?: String }

then.message: RssFeed '{id}' has a `feedUrl` that is not a web address. Start it with http:// or https://.
